verdict.rationale: Expensify documents an Integration Server API with generated service credentials (partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret) and OAuth2 tokens. The secret-rotation note refers to 'all systems using it', which implies non-interactive programmatic use, so automation without the UI is plausible. Missing for 10: any official CLI or headless runner, CI-specific guidance or examples, documentation of which operations the API covers, and hands-on corroboration of automated or CI usage.
